static_review.method: view_image on three decoded local PNG files
observations: Two rows and two columns retain the intended full-group/partial-group and fixed-reference/actual arrangement.
Counters and moving bright blocks are visible, with the same displayed values and positions in each paired column at all three inspected frames.
CTA labels are present at frames 20 and 39 but small in this 240x136 fixture; advertising caption readability and typography are not accepted by this check.

AAC (Advanced Audio Coding)

explanation: Initial 22 methods had test harness path/key errors; next run had one missing reference sequence name; 27 methods then passed.
Initial full runner and font smoke used -I and hid installed optional libraries; no product or dependency changes were needed.
restricted plus commercial_ad permission is allowed by the existing gate; free-text restrictions are not interpreted.
Explicit blocked was rejected at exit 7 with PROJECT_INVALID caused by RIGHTS_STATUS_BLOCKED; the third smoke expected the wrong top-level code.
Review reproduced two boundary failures: unpublished staging manifests and a version-directory junction escaping the library. Both are fixed in final source.
The first boundary filter ran zero tests because unittest -k is substring matching, not a regular expression. Its log is retained and is not a pass.

The full runner omitted inherited PYTHONPATH for a subprocess and the explicit existing native Rubber Band toolchain. Its subsequent full run was interrupted when this was diagnosed; the corrected runner records and supplies both paths. No product changes for this runner correction.

The earlier successful 27-method run and smoke are development records. The run planned for 812 methods actually ran 785 with one subprocess import failure and three skips, and also lost source-byte freeze after two tests and product fixes were added.
Final 29-method targeted, 814-method full, public smoke, media and wheel checks were rerun from scratch on the same frozen final source.
